limitations: Release/default Windows FP controls. Debug, unmasked exceptions, allocation failure and arbitrary host concurrency remain unclosed.
Safe Rust owns bitmap initialization, initialized pixels, drawing traversal, final packed alpha and bitmap lifetime. No numeric assembly was added.
Native aligned shifted views retain plane pointers, zero-sized allocation identity and xy accounting. They remain transitional host/output views; counters do not measure total Rust heap.
Production planar addition follows DrawItem routing to normal Draw. Direct unsupported planar AdditionDraw diagnostics, unsupported bitmap layouts and debug-box macro integration remain unclosed.
Bounded six-DWORD switches only; invalid addresses, exhausted histories and unknown source pixels actually consumed are unresolved. No arbitrary overlapping input/output alias guarantee.

Packed padding and uninitialized bpp are never sampled. Planar initialized padding, shared native bitmap aliases, composite release and final destruction are compared. A separate FFI test verifies bitmap survival after overlay and composite destruction.
External output-surface blits, frame/creator state, caches, color conversion, host adapters and vendors remain in scope. Experimental switches stay opt-in.
COM checks use fresh disconnected objects and private volatile HKCU keys without DLL registration. Graph playback, media negotiation, UI and all host applications remain unclosed.
